```artifact
Feature: User Experience and System Performance for Consultation Requests

  @VIRTUA-2.5-18
  Scenario: People with no computer background should be able to use the system relatively easily
    Given a user with no computer background accesses the system
    When the user attempts to navigate the system
    Then the user should be able to complete a Consultation Request without significant difficulty

  @VIRTUA-2.5-19
  Scenario: The system should be designed to keep the system navigation very simple and intuitive
    Given a user accesses the system
    When the user navigates through the system
    Then the navigation should be simple and intuitive with clear labels and minimal steps

  @VIRTUA-2.5-20
  Scenario Outline: A normal Consultation Request should get filled in less than 5 minutes
    Given a user accesses the system
    When the user fills in a Consultation Request with <data>
    Then the time taken to fill in the Consultation Request should be less than 5 minutes

    Examples:
      | data          |
      | minimal data  |
      | relevant data |

  @VIRTUA-2.6-1
  Scenario: Installation Guide shall be prepared
    Given the system documentation is available
    When the user accesses the Installation Guide
    Then the Installation Guide should be prepared and available for download

  @VIRTUA-2.6-2
  Scenario: User Manual for end users shall be prepared
    Given the system documentation is available
    When the user accesses the User Manual
    Then the User Manual should be prepared and available for download
```
